topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% antenna efficiency reduces effective radiated power, increasing path loss and decreasing signal-to-noise ratio. This impacts link budget margins, capacity, and reliability, necessitating stronger error correction modulation schemes, which trade off spectral efficiency for reliability, affecting network resource allocation and traffic management.
reference_context: SatCom systems require careful link budget analysis, considering antenna gains, noise temperatures, and power constraints to ensure reliable transmission.
